    n = int(input().strip())
    p = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
    b = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))

    visited = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    changes = 0

    for i in range(n):
        pos = i
        rev = 0
        while (pos, rev) not in visited[pos]:
            visited[pos].add((pos, rev))
            pos = p[pos] - 1
            rev ^= b[pos]

        if len(visited[pos]) < 2:
            changes += 1

    print(changes)
